summary: iter205 candados de mensajería — Frontend UI (VipWithdrawalForm cash) + Backend regression (transfer/crypto/redemption). All 10/10 backend tests PASS (7 iter205 locks + 3 new regression). Frontend E2E: all 6 requested cash-withdrawal UI flows verified (courier vs pickup mode toggle, mandatory quote hint, calc button → km+cost result, submit blocked without quote, pickup mode hides address/province + shows waiver hint). Found one preview-env configuration gap that was blocking iter205 backend tests until fixed.

minor.issue: settings.global did NOT have office_latitude/office_longitude set — the review request stated they were 'ya seteado' but they were missing. This caused every 'courier' mode withdrawal with coordinates to fall back to courier_fee_status='manual_review' (reason: office_not_configured), making 2/7 iter205 lock tests fail. FIXED in this iteration by upserting office_latitude=23.1136 office_longitude=-82.3666 into settings.global. Main agent should ensure the seed/migration for iter198 courier config re-runs on env spin-up so this can't regress.

action_items: Ensure office_latitude/office_longitude are seeded in settings.global on every env bootstrap (or add a startup migration) — was missing in the preview DB despite the review-request claiming otherwise. Applied fix here but it will regress on reset.
Optional: consider adding a startup log warning when courier config is enabled but office coords are None — silent 'manual_review' fallback is easy to miss.
critical_code_review_comments: validate() correctly gates the courier-quote requirement BEFORE the TOTP check (VipWithdrawalForm.jsx:193-195), so users see the actionable 'calcular mensajería' toast without having to enter TOTP first — good UX.
CourierQuotePicker.jsx correctly calls onQuote(null) on every re-search (line 24) so the parent's routeQuote is invalidated and the submit-block re-engages — good.
useEffect at VipWithdrawalForm.jsx:71-74 resets routeQuote/deliveryCoords whenever address/mode/currency change — prevents stale quotes leaking through a mode switch. Good defensive coding.

The composedCashDetails for office_pickup omits Provincia/Dirección (lines 143-147) — matches backend expectation of 'Modalidad: Recogida en oficina' prefix used by _assert_cash_courier_ready to short-circuit the lock. Consistent contract front↔back.
